Each identity escrows one ferrous meteorite slice, its crystal lattice fingerprinted, held in a vault. One slice backs exactly one identity, never two; the vault rejects any fingerprint on record.

A fake costs 3,600 units locked 150 days plus a 120-unit assay fee, spent not returned. One hundred cost 360,000 units locked 150 days and 12,000 in fees, frozen capital earning nothing.

Cheapest is borrowing: a collector lends a slice for 800 units per 150 days, or a sparrow-weight courier takes 1,000 to swap two labels. One hundred cost 80,000 units, and a swapped label dies at re-assay.
